data.summary: Meridian Bank and Nimbus Labs kicked off the Nimbus Ledger Sync pilot to automate UPI settlements reconciliation. The team agreed on a go-live date of November 30, 2026, limited to UPI reconciliation only. Key technical and administrative tasks were assigned to prepare the sandbox, security reviews, and data mappings.
decisions: Pilot go-live date is set for Monday 30 November 2026.
Phase one is limited to UPI reconciliation only, with NEFT and IMPS deferred to phase two.
Customer-managed encryption keys are not supported; keys are managed by Nimbus in AWS KMS.

action_items.title: Send our standard mutual NDA to Neha
Set up the sandbox environment and send API credentials
Give the IP ranges we need allowlisted
Write a mapping document that says which Meridian field feeds which Nimbus field
Nominate two analysts from my team for user acceptance testing and send names
Prepare anonymised sample transaction files from the layout you gave us

follow_up_email.subject: Follow-up: Meridian Bank x Nimbus Labs Project Kickoff
follow_up_email.body:
Hi Neha,

Thanks for a productive kickoff meeting today. As agreed, we are targeting a go-live date of Monday 30 November 2026 for the UPI reconciliation pilot.

Action items and next steps are currently being tracked on our side. We look forward to working together.

Best regards,
Nimbus Labs
